ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 12722, June 9, 1989>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Repeal of Other Statutes) The Regulation on Qualifications of Officers of Tobacco Production Cooperatives is hereby repealed.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tobacco and Ginseng Corporation Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 9 1, "tobacco production cooperatives and the federation thereof established under the Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act" shall be replaced with "tobacco production cooperatives and the Central Association thereof established under the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act."
(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Tobacco Business Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (1) 2 and paragraph (2) of the same Article, "Federation of Tobacco Production Cooperatives" shall each be replaced with "Central Association of Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives."
Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Tobacco Cultivation Instructors) A tobacco cultivation instructor under the former provisions at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed a tobacco cultivation instructor under this Decree.
Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Prescribed Number of Personnel) Where, at the time this Decree enters into force, the actual number of personnel of a cooperative or the Central Association exceeds the prescribed number under its articles of association or other provisions, the excess personnel shall be deemed part of the prescribed number until the actual number coincides with the prescribed number.
